💡 OpenGait | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Developing, training, and evaluating custom gait recognition models.
✨ Key Features: • Flexible and extensible framework • Gait recognition model design and comparison • Support for multiple datasets (GaitLU-1M, SUSTech1K, etc.) • Integration of advanced models (FoundationGait, BiggerGait, DenoisingGait, etc.) • Published research in top-tier conferences (CVPR, TPAMI, ECCV, NeurIPS, MICCAI, AAAI)
📖 Summary: OpenGait is a flexible and extensible Python framework for gait recognition, enabling researchers to design and compare state-of-the-art models. It supports various datasets and has been highlighted in CVPR2023 and TPAMI2025.
